SELECT G.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", G.TITLE AS "title", G.OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", M.NAME AS "ownerName", G.STATUS AS "status", G.PURPOSE AS "purpose", G.REGION_SIDO AS "regionSido", G.REGION_SIGUNGU AS "regionSigungu", G.LAT AS "lat", G.LNG AS "lng", G.AMOUNT AS "amount", G.MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GM.MEMBER_ID) FROM GYE_MEMBER GM WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND GM.MEMBER_ID != G.OWNER_ID ) + 1 AS "currentMembers", G.MONTHS AS "months", G.PAY_DAY AS "payDay", G.ASSUMED_RATE AS "assumedRate", G.VISIBILITY AS "visibility", G.DESCRIPTION AS "description", G.RULES_TITLE AS "rulesTitle", G.RULES_BODY AS "rulesBody", G.ORDER_CONFIRMED_YN AS "orderConfirmedYn", CASE WHEN G.OWNER_ID = #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} THEN 'OWNER' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GYE_MEMBER GM WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND GM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 'MEMBER' ELSE 'NONE' END AS "role" FROM GYE_GROUP G LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = G.OWNER_ID WHERE G.VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND G.STATUS != 'DISSOLVED'
AND ( G.REGION_SIDO LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR G.REGION_SIGUNGU LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR (G.REGION_SIDO || ' ' || G.REGION_SIGUNGU) LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' ESCAPE '\' )
AND G.PURPOSE = #{purpose}
AND LOWER(G.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY G.GROUP_ID DESC

SELECT G.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", G.TITLE AS "title", G.OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", G.STATUS AS "status", G.PURPOSE AS "purpose", G.REGION_SIDO AS "regionSido", G.REGION_SIGUNGU AS "regionSigungu", G.AMOUNT AS "amount", G.MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GM.MEMBER_ID) FROM GYE_MEMBER GM WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND GM.MEMBER_ID != G.OWNER_ID ) + 1 AS "currentMembers", G.MONTHS AS "months", G.PAY_DAY AS "payDay", G.ASSUMED_RATE AS "assumedRate", G.VISIBILITY AS "visibility", G.DESCRIPTION AS "description", 'OWNER' AS "role" FROM GYE_GROUP G WHERE G.OWNER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY G.GROUP_ID DESC

SELECT G.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", G.TITLE AS "title", G.OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", G.STATUS AS "status", G.PURPOSE AS "purpose", G.REGION_SIDO AS "regionSido", G.REGION_SIGUNGU AS "regionSigungu", G.AMOUNT AS "amount", G.MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GM.MEMBER_ID) FROM GYE_MEMBER GM WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND GM.MEMBER_ID != G.OWNER_ID ) + 1 AS "currentMembers", G.MONTHS AS "months", G.PAY_DAY AS "payDay", G.ASSUMED_RATE AS "assumedRate", G.VISIBILITY AS "visibility", G.DESCRIPTION AS "description", 'MEMBER' AS "role" FROM GYE_GROUP G WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GYE_MEMBER GM WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND GM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) AND G.OWNER_ID != #{memberId} ORDER BY G.GROUP_ID DESC

SELECT GM.GYE_MEMBER_ID AS "gyeMemberId", GM.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", GM.MEMBER_ID AS "memberId", M.NAME AS "memberName", CASE WHEN G.OWNER_ID = GM.MEMBER_ID THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS "role", GM.STATUS AS "status", GM.JOINED_AT AS "joinedAt", GM.WARNING_COUNT AS "warningCount" FROM GYE_MEMBER GM JOIN MEMBER M ON GM.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID JOIN GYE_GROUP G ON GM.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN GM.MEMBER_ID = G.OWNER_ID THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, GM.JOINED_AT ASC, GM.GYE_MEMBER_ID ASC
